# netbox_l2vpn (Data Source)

A layer 2 VPN (vpn.l2vpn).

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/vpn/l2vpn/):

> A L2VPN object is NetBox is a representation of a layer 2 bridge technology such as VXLAN, VPLS, or EPL. Each L2VPN can be identified by name as well as by an optional unique identifier (VNI would be an example). Once created, L2VPNs can be terminated to [interfaces](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/interface/) and [VLANs](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/ipam/vlan/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_l2vpn" "test" {
  name = "test-l2vpn"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `identifier` (Number) Numeric identifier (e.g. the VNI or VPLS id), not the NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly unique shorthand; derived from name when not set.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.
- `type` (String) L2VPN technology. One of: vpws, vpls, vxlan, vxlan-evpn, mpls-evpn, pbb-evpn, epl, evpl, ep-lan, evp-lan, ep-tree, evp-tree, evpn-vpws, spb.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `export_target_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of exported route targets.
- `import_target_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of imported route targets.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: active, planned, decommissioning.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `url` (String)
